hypothesis: A fixed 50/50 portfolio emission - half the dots in the 3-12 px collar around the mapped catalogue (the regime the holdout validates) and half in geophysical corridors beyond 12 px (the blind-basin regime only the hidden test can score) - retains the holdout-demonstrable coverage benefit while staying spatially unlike every informative prior.
mechanism: collar = 3 <= distance-to-catalogue <= 12 px; corridor = EXP-2 primary region beyond 12 px; each arm 20,000 dots from a quasi-hexagonal 3 px lattice in raster order; binary 1.0 emission; zero dots on the catalogue.
named_non_fault_process: Collar arm: road/rail/fence lineaments and digitisation offsets parallel to mapped traces. Corridor arm: shallow volcanic contacts and dyke swarms. Both stated, neither proven rejected.

leakage_canary.note: geometric emission with no fitted model; the only learned quantity is the fixed corridor thresholds, so no classifier AUC can be computed and none is claimed

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.scope: every local prior raster in this checkout plus the 12 highest-scoring predecessor rasters fetched from their public GitHub mirrors; the full 992-raster registry is NOT re-restored here
correlation_overlap_vs_registry.note_on_self_overlap: 0.97 forward overlap with this session's own EXP-2 corridor artifact is expected because the collar+corridor design contains that lattice; it is a within-session nesting, not a prior submission
